eligibility.quote: Issue #262 asks for the header rename ("the suffix of header files should be changed from *.h to *.hpp"), and a commenter anticipates the downstream break: "renaming the header files will create a problem on other packages that depends on this package." (https://github.com/ros-perception/vision_opencv/issues/262#issuecomment-629760429). The vision_opencv maintainer confirms the removal: "All .h files have been deprecated in I-turtle, and have removed for J-turtle onwards!" (https://github.com/ros-perception/vision_opencv/issues/262#issuecomment-1760609581), done in PR #517 / commit 5d6148ab "remove header files that were deprecated in I-turtle". The Autoware maintainer's fix PR #11873 "fix: add cv_bridge.hpp support", filed under the Jazzy-support tracking issue, replaces the consumer's include: "-#include <cv_bridge/cv_bridge.h>" / "+#include <cv_bridge/cv_bridge.hpp>  // for ROS 2 Jazzy or newer" (https://github.com/autowarefoundation/autoware_universe/pull/11873/files). This is a maintainer-confirmed consumer/provider mismatch; there is no reproducer or error log.

failed_conditions.quote: All .h files have been deprecated in I-turtle, and have removed for J-turtle onwards!

loudness.quote: No compiler output for this package is shown in any source. The Jazzy-support thread reports build status only as charts (e.g. "Current packages build status for autoware_universe:" followed by an image, https://github.com/autowarefoundation/autoware_universe/issues/11418#issuecomment-3757294247) and later "Once these final PRs are merged, everything compiles!" (https://github.com/autowarefoundation/autoware_universe/issues/11418#issuecomment-3787249827), neither attributed to this header.

resolution.quote: PR #11873 body: "## How was this PR tested?" / "Compiles locally with jazzy." (https://github.com/autowarefoundation/autoware_universe/pull/11873); consumer at PR head 59bd3d1242446ec4068d0b3bff6ab35a61ee13cc (merged as f50b5c39). The provider is identified by distro only; Jazzy carried a single vision_opencv release (4.1.0-1) on that date, so the provider revision is 4.1.0 by the rosdistro record rather than by the PR's own words.
